content: {"summary":"The outage on edge‑gateway node 03 in January 2025 was caused by TLS handshakes being aborted because the edge presented an expired intermediate certificate. Clients dropped the handshake, no access‑log entries appeared and request rates fell. Troubleshooting should follow the edge‑gateway TLS runbook: check Envoy handshake stats, inspect the certificate chain with openssl s_client on each pod, verify the edge‑public‑tls Secret contains the correct chain, and restart the deployment so the new secret is loaded, then confirm all pods serve the updated notAfter dates and traffic normalises.","likely_cause":"Expired intermediate certificate in the edge‑gateway TLS chain","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"TLS handshakes were aborted because the intermediate certificate served by the pods had expired","evidence_ids":["INC-0068#1"],"quote":"intermediate the pods hand out, while the certificate for our own name had not run out"},{"text":"Clients abandoned the TLS handshake, resulting in no access‑log entries and a drop in request rates","evidence_ids":["RB-025#1"],"quote":"Clients abandon the handshake before sending any HTTP.
